node.statement: Threshold and amplification identification: let e_cmp>0 be the universal constant supplied by lem-compcb-amplified-compression. If e=delta+epsilon<=e_cmp, P,Q are delta-projections in the extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, and n>=1, then with P_n=I_n tensor P and Q_n=I_n tensor Q one has Co_{P_n,Q_n}=1_{M_n} tensor Co_{P,Q}; applying the same cited lemma to the ordered pair (Q,P) also gives Co_{Q_n,P_n}=1_{M_n} tensor Co_{Q,P}.
